messages:
Ivy: FYI customer ran the Electron quickstart and their UI shows the request completed but the chat window never populated with streaming tokens.
Marcus: Did the console show any billing prompts?
Ivy: Yes, small banner: "Enable trial to unlock streaming". They ignored it because quickstart log printed "200 OK".
Devon (devex): Can you paste the quickstart log + curl result?
Ivy: curl to /v1/streams returns chunked payload. Electron quickstart logs: "Fetch finished: 200" then app closes stream handler.
Anya (sdk): Electron uses node-fetch under the hood; if response lacks Transfer-Encoding: chunked the stream reader resolves the body immediately. If backend is returning a short non-chunked body when billing inactive, SDK needs to surface an explicit error.
BillingBot: Note: streaming endpoints are restricted for billing_inactive workspaces. The gateway may return a quick non-chunked response to limit resources. See /billing docs.
Clara (ux): This is a UX trap: users see 200 and assume success. Quickstarts should check workspace billing status before attempting streaming.
Marcus: Repro steps: 1) invite user to workspace 2) skip billing modal 3) run electron quickstart -> log shows 200 and no UI tokens.
Devon (devex): Proposal: 1) quickstart: add a lightweight preflight call GET /v1/workspace that checks billing_state and warns with modal (devex) 2) SDK: detect short non-chunked responses for stream requests and raise BillingInactiveError with guidance link (sdk) 3) backend: prefer explicit 402 JSON for programmatic clients or include an initial error chunk for streams (infra) 4) docs: add troubleshooting note "200 but no streaming tokens" (docs).
Anya (sdk): Quick patch: Node/Electron SDK will inspect headers: if request is stream-type and content-length < 1024 and body contains "billing" or "activate" -> throw BillingInactiveError. I'll open PR.
Clara (ux): I'll draft the quickstart modal copy: "Activate trial to enable streaming. Click to add payment method or request trial activation." Also add a CTA to run a billing preflight check.
Devon (devex): Action owners: infra for backend change (Devon -> infra), Anya for SDK heuristic, Clara for quickstart UX, Marcus for docs. Let's add a telemetry event to count quickstart->billing failures.
Ivy: I'll send the user's logs to Sentry and link here.
Marcus: Great. Once SDK patch is published we should post a short note in #announcements for anyone using quickstarts.
Ivy: Thanks all, going to follow up with customer with workaround (enable trial) and ETA for fix. :thumbsup:
